headline: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Limited files Monitoring Agency Report for Q1 FY27
sum: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Limited submitted its Monitoring Agency Report to NSE for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, marking a formal filing milestone in its public market progression.
implication: The Monitoring Agency Report filing signals completion of post-IPO share lock-in compliance reporting under SEBI IPO norms; counsel must ensure all shareholders' statutory holding periods and transfer restrictions are correctly tracked through listing lifecycle.
detail: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Limited, a healthcare operator, filed its Monitoring Agency Report with the National Stock Exchange covering the quarter ended 30 June 2026. This report is a mandatory post-IPO disclosure requirement under SEBI regulations, confirming adherence to lock-in and share-transfer compliance for promoter and other restricted shareholders. The filing was submitted on 13 August 2026.
